_meta.source: nhl_project/output/shots_2025.csv + skaters_2025.csv + goalies_2025.csv (MoneyPuck shot-level and game-by-game data), built by nhl_project/build_player_pool.py
_meta.note: This is NOT a live daily slate — no current-season schedule/injury feed is wired up yet. Each player's 'opponent' fields are their most recent real game in these files, used as a stand-in matchup. games_played, icetime, assists, points, on-ice % and zone starts are real MoneyPuck game-by-game values. ICF/iSCF are unblocked attempts from the shot file; HDCF/iHDCF are those within 20 ft; I_F_highDangerShots/I_F_mediumDangerShots are MoneyPuck's own xG-based counts. DaysSinceLastGoal counts games played since the last goal. Goalie GA60_proxy/xGA60_proxy are per 60 minutes of real ice time; wins are credited to the team's goalie with the most ice time.
